title: The Moving Stones
topic: วิทยาศาสตร์
lines: For decades, visitors to Racetrack Playa, a dry lake in California, were
puzzled by a strange sight: heavy rocks, some weighing over 300 kilograms,
that seemed to have moved across the flat ground by **themselves**, leaving
long trails behind them. No one had ever seen **them** move, and theories
ranged from strong winds to magnetic forces and even aliens.
In 2014, a team of scientists finally solved the mystery. They placed GPS
trackers on several rocks and set up cameras nearby. During one cold winter,
a thin layer of rain froze on the lake at night. When the sun came out,
the ice broke into large, thin sheets. Light winds then pushed **these**
